speaker: Leonard
text: Deal is kind of a strong word. Um, but I just, I think it'd be a nice gesture on your part. Well, there you go. Problem solved.

speaker: Leonard
text: She'll get it when she gets it. A successful quest. Now let's find a gas station with a clean bathroom.

speaker: Leonard
text: No, the problem isn't solved. He just blew us off.

speaker: Leonard
text: I've got it. He didn't remember me because the last time we met, I was in a Halloween costume.

speaker: Leonard
text: Come on, Leonard, let's go.

speaker: Leonard
text: No, you can leave if you want to. I'm gonna see this through.

speaker: Leonard
text: I guess technically that was my fault.

speaker: Leonard
text: I'm not leaving here without Penny's money.

speaker: Leonard
text: What happened to your backup?

speaker: Leonard
text: I don't need backup. I have right on my side. And I'm wearing cargo shorts under my pants. Congratulations. You may not have succeeded in getting cash, but you did secure a formal acknowledgement of the debt.

speaker: Leonard
text: Maybe we should have your head notarized.

speaker: Leonard
text: If anybody cares, I still have to pee.

speaker: Leonard
text: It's kind of a fashionable look these days. Hello, Penny.

speaker: Penny
text: Maybe if you're working on a tuna boat. Sheldon, here is your money. Thank you very much. It helped a lot.

speaker: Leonard
text: Sarcasm?

speaker: Penny
text: No.

speaker: Leonard
text: Darn, I can't seem to get the hang of that. Hey, I know it's none of my business, but where did the money come from?

speaker: Penny
text: Well, I cut back my expenses, like you said, and paid for a few more hours at the restaurant. But the biggest thing was, out of the blue, when Kurt shows up, give me the money he owes me.

speaker: Leonard
text: Really? Did he say why?

speaker: Penny
text: Yes. He said he was feeling guilty and wanted to do what was right.

speaker: Leonard
text: That's it? Did he give any reason as to why he came to this moral epiphany?

speaker: Penny
text: Nope. I just think he's really changed. We're having dinner tomorrow night and I get to wear my new beret. Bye, guys.

speaker: Leonard
text: Bye. Well done, Leonard. The true hero doesn't seek adulation. He fights for right and justice simply because it's his nature.

speaker: Leonard
text: Penny's hooking up with her jerk of an ex-boyfriend, and I have indelible ink on my forehead.

speaker: Leonard
text: That's your badge of honor. You're a warrior's wound, if you will. I was wrong. Minstrels will write songs about you.

speaker: Leonard
text: Great.

speaker: Leonard
text: There once was a brave lad named Leonard, with a five-five fiddle-dee-dee. He faced the fears of the giant, while Raj just wanted to pee.
